_about: T-049 M1 exit: PLAN.md §1 M1 exit check scenarios mapped to the exact test cases that prove each (JUnit classname = file, name = 'describe > test'). Checked by check-scenarios.py: every scenario title exists in docs/spec/02-PRD.md §8; every mapped test name occurs in its file; with a JUnit report, every mapped test case is present once, passed and not skipped, and the report has no failure. 'items' are M1 requirements without a PRD §8 scenario title, checked the same way. 'proves' states which Given/When/Then parts the cases assert; 'open' names a part not proven in M1 and the task where it completes.
